text: This report recommends approval of a Rental Housing Demolition application which proposes to demolish 50 rental dwelling units located at 1497-1501 Queen Street West and 89-91 Beaty Avenue. A total of 54 rental units are proposed to be replaced as part of the new development on the site. The proposal includes a Tenant Assistance Plan that addresses the right of existing tenants to return to replacement rental units at similar rents and provides financial compensation to mitigate hardship. The proposed development on the site at 1497-1501 Queen Street West and 89-91 Beaty Avenue is the subject of a related Official Plan and Zoning By-law Amendment application (26 118047 STE 04 OZ). The proposed development would permit a 10- and 7-storey mixed use building consisting of 141 affordable rental units, including 54 rental replacement units.
